hero_1: I design, manage and automate modern platforms and infrastructure.
hero_2: DevOps engineer focused on CI/CD, Kubernetes, GitLab automation, Linux systems and open-source technologies.
about_1: I'm a DevOps & Platform Engineer based in Rome, Italy. I've been working with technology since the '90s. I have a strong focus on modern infrastructure, automation and platform engineering. I work daily with Linux environments, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, containerized workloads, Kubernetes and observability stacks. I started argaar.net as a personal tech space long before social platforms existed.
experience_cgi: Working on deployment and operation of internal products across on-premise and SaaS environments in the Earth Observation domain. Managing Kubernetes clusters (cloud and on-prem), defining backup strategies, improving automation and KPIs, and enforcing security best practices across the platform.
experience_lutech: Designed and operated Kubernetes platforms based on Talos Linux. Built GitLab-driven CI/CD pipelines and API-based automation for on-prem clusters. Implemented observability with Prometheus and Graylog and DevSecOps pipelines including SBOM (CycloneDX), SAST, DAST and container security. Managed internal registries and tooling such as Harbor, Nexus, SonarQube and DependencyTrack.
experience_other: Strong background in Linux systems, networking, monitoring and virtualization. Managed large-scale infrastructures and monitoring platforms, providing a solid foundation for modern DevOps and platform engineering work.
now_1: Right now I work as a Lead DevOps Engineer focusing on Kubernetes-based platforms, CI/CD automation with GitLab, and DevSecOps practices.
now_2: I spend most of my time improving delivery pipelines, observability, security, and reliability of both on-premise and cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on pragmatic automation and developer experience.
principles_1_text: Prefer boring, proven solutions. Systems should fail predictably and recover quickly.
principles_2_text: If a task is repeatable, it should be automated. Humans are for decisions, not toil.
principles_3_text: If you can't see it, you can't operate it. Metrics, logs and alerts are not optional.
principles_4_text: Platforms should make the right thing easy and the wrong thing hard.
